subject: Pilot onboarding paused — request: extension + sandbox grant
messages:
From: Emma Liang <emma@clearledger.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot onboarding paused — request: extension + sandbox grant

Hi Marissa,

Quick note from our end: our engineering team hit a blocker while wiring up the webhook + SSO flow to the Redwood sandbox. The error manifests as a token exchange timeout and a downstream mapping mismatch when events hit our staging queue — we (unfortunately) don't have a clean workaround without a code drop on our side.

This has effectively paused our pilot onboarding. We had a demo window scheduled for next Wednesday but the build is blocked, and the team expects ~5 working days to fix, test, and redeploy. Given the delay, we're running low on our sandbox quota (we estimated usage for the demo and ramp).

Could Redwood consider a short extension to the pilot window (30 days) plus a modest sandbox top-up so we can complete the end-to-end validation once the engineering fix is in? We'd request 100k tokens (rough estimate from our infra team) to cover the demo + checkpoint testing.

We want to keep momentum — the product team is excited and the exec sponsor is watching — so any assistance would help avoid losing the demo slot. Happy to provide logs or a short call if that helps.

Thanks,
Emma Liang
Senior Product Manager
ClearLedger

Hi Emma — thanks for the clear summary and for flagging the urgency.

Sorry to hear the SSO/webhook handshake is causing a stall. I’ve looped Dev and David from platform engineering to triage. High level: we are supportive of keeping the demo on track and generally approve short pilot extensions and sandbox top-ups for integration blockers like this — we just need the technical thumbs-up and an estimate from eng.

Proposed immediate plan:

- If engineering confirms ~3–5 dev days, I will push a one-time sandbox grant and approve a 30-day pilot extension pending the SOW amendment.

We want to avoid losing your demo slot. I’ll follow up once Dev has an ETA.

Hi all — dug into the log Emma shared. TL;DR: two related issues.

1) OAuth token-exchange timeout: ClearLedger's staging identity provider (IdP) is returning long handshake times for refresh; the Redwood sandbox times out at 8s by default. We can extend the internal timeout for the sandbox environment to 20s as a short-term mitigation (config change) but that's not ideal long-term.

2) Event payload mapping: when the delayed token exchange triggers a retry, an upstream library (third-party parser) sometimes drops the `customer_id` field for specific event batches. Fix requires library upgrade + schema-safe fallback — approx 2–3 dev days to implement + 1 day QA.

Workaround we can implement quickly: increase sandbox handshake timeout (config) + add a middleware that preserves the customer_id on retry. That should unblock the demo in 24–48 hours. The permanent fix (library upgrade + QA) is the 3–4 day work.

For the ask: 100k tokens may be borderline depending on demo cadence. I recommend a 120k token top-up to give buffer for retries + validation. I’ll attach a short SOW for the change and the debug notes.

Attachments: sow_proposed_changes_v1.pdf

If this works for you, Marissa, happy to have the config change scheduled tomorrow morning and then follow with the code fix next week.

- Dev

(technical note included in the attachment)

Emma —

Thanks Dev for the clear breakdown and Emma for the patience. We’ll move forward as follows:

1) Redwood will issue a one-time sandbox grant of 120,000 tokens to ClearLedger to cover the demo + validation window.
2) We will extend the pilot window by 30 days from the current expiry date.
3) Dev will apply the temporary sandbox timeout change tomorrow morning to unblock the demo; the permanent library upgrade will be scheduled for next week.

Markus — tagging you to confirm the one-time token grant and get sign-off on the small amendment to the pilot SOW (I’ve attached the proposed SOW for legal/finance). Emma, once Markus confirms we’ll send the DocuSign amendment link and note the HubSpot deal update.

Next steps for Emma: please confirm the preferred demo day/time after the config change (we’ll stay flexible), and share any additional logs if they surface.

Appreciate the urgency here — we want to keep ClearLedger on track.

Best,
